previous.description:
GitExtensions plugin that displays branches hierarchically in a persistent non-modal
tree window.  Branches separated by '/' are shown as nested folder nodes under three
fixed root sections — LOCAL, REMOTES and TAGS.

Features:
  • Real-time filter across all sections
  • Right-click context menu: Checkout, Nova branch, Mesclar, Rebase, Renomear, Excluir
  • Double-click / Enter to checkout
  • Bold highlight for the currently checked-out branch
  • Working-directory combo populated from GitExtensions history
  • Auto-refresh on checkout and repository switch
  • Status bar: Local N | Remoto N | Tags N

previous.description: Let LLMs and AI agents "watch" video. Zakira.Replay turns any video source — YouTube URLs, conference recordings, course lectures, local files — into speaker-attributed transcripts (captions or local Whisper STT), frame-level OCR and structured vision (local or LLM-routed), slide-aware grouping, and timestamped JSON evidence that agents can reason over. Ships as both a CLI (`zakira-replay`) and an MCP server (`zakira-replay mcp serve`) in one .NET 10 binary.
